summary: Reviewed 10 files touched by the documentos->documents/tipo->type rename for data-fetching/state-management correctness. Naming mechanics of the rename itself (query keys, DTO field names, zod schemas) are consistent end-to-end for contracts.documents, shares.documents, and query-config.ts's documents-funcionario cache key. However the review surfaced pre-existing, currently-live correctness defects directly in scope: (1) useDocumentosFuncionario.ts's filters.funcionario_id is silently dropped by GET /hr/employees, so the RH Documentos tab query always returns every employee of the tenant mislabeled as documents, independent of which funcionario is selected (find-77fdb69b); (2) the same hook's create/update mutations send fields CreateEmployeeDto/UpdateEmployeeDto do not whitelist, so every document upload 400s after a real R2 upload already happened, and cache invalidation never fires because the mutation never resolves (find-08bd56c9); (3) ContratoViewModal.tsx's Assinatura tab is permanently driven by a hard-coded-empty useDocuments() stub, so alreadySent is always false and the resend/status UI for real Autentique/DocuSign sends never activates (find-ce45a25f); (4) a guard test file's own filename was not migrated to the canonical documents term despite its contents being fully migrated (find-789be777). No new query-key collisions, missing invalidation, or render-loop risk were found that were introduced by the rename itself -- the rename was executed cleanly; the findings above are real backend-contract-drift/data-fetching defects uncovered during this pass. VERDICT: FAIL (findings recorded, no code changed).
